measurements.note: Held back: Fiberlogy's data sheet prints this 51 °C "@ 1.8 MPa"; its product page prints the same 51 °C "@ 0.45 MPa" (V012179), beside the same density, tensile strength, modulus, Vicat and glass transition. A heavier load cannot deflect a bar at a higher temperature, so whichever label is right the product's HDT at 0.45 MPa is at least this figure: the 0.45 MPa reading stands, and this 1.8 MPa reading, which could overstate the product, is held back and backs nothing until the maker says which load it is (D149).
